Sybil resistance via quadratic vote pricing on independence tiers. Each epoch reviewers are classified: canyon tier for isolated neighborhoods, karst tier for porous clusters, garden tier for long-bonded groups.

Operation: over 5 shared referral edges demotes a reviewer one tier; 20 mutual attestations over 10 epochs promote it. The k-th ballot costs k^2 * 0.25 units escrowed 6 epochs; demoted reviewers pay 2x.

Attacker math: 10 sybils voting once spend 2.5 units; twice each costs 10 while a pass returns 3, so volume voting loses before clawback.
